about: Name tidy-up for the Belgravian people index (Steve, 14 Nov 2026). people.py reads this file. Each entry joins the printed forms listed in 'forms' to the person named in 'into' ('intoKey' is the index key when given). 'from'/'to' (years) or 'items' (item ids) limit which mentions move; 'exceptItems' are left where they were. Only entries with apply: true act; medium and low ones wait for Steve. To undo a merge, set apply to false (or delete the entry) and rebuild. Printed text is never changed: every printed form stays in the person's aka list.

evidence: B150-04 prints 'Tom Carter' and 'C.T.Carter' together for 'War Time Runner No.1'; Tom Carter goes by his middle name
These entries were printed 'C. T. Carter' (or 'C. Carter'), 1930-1981; the first name 'Chris' was never printed for them
The real Chris Carter appears only from 1982, so he keeps his own entries
B109-45 prints 'H. E. Footer (otherwise known as Our Bert) joined the Club in 1922'
B28-15 and B33-11 call him 'Our Bert' in race reports

Steve, 8 Nov 2026: Bert is the only grown-up Footer in the archive (Bertie was a child, Florrie was Bert in panto costume), so any other Footer is Bert; 'Big Boy Footer' (B27-04, team manager at the 1929 outing) is a joke name for him

Two walking results, 1954 and 1956, when Doug was a young Belgrave walker; no other Don Fotheringham anywhere in the archive
Could be a misprint of 'Doug' or a real Don: nothing prints both
